note: S14 draft (P6-S14-T1). Candidates only: nothing here is verified until the live run and review record it in docs/plans/phase0_spikes.md. 'unverified' is not a valid rule version, so no rule can match before reduce substitutes the exact tested version. P6-T01a moves reviewed rules into the production catalog through its own pipeline.

coverage.note: rate_limits windows survive captureRecord and intake. A window is evidence only when non-empty; null, {} or absent prove nothing. Discriminates only if alternative methods are shown not to emit it (not-run: D-P6-14).
message.usage (tokens, cache, service_tier), model and cost are never method evidence. Live run records key names only, to look for an explicit field for review.

payload.rate_limits.plan_type is the strongest candidate (survives parseLine and codexRateLimits), but its enum literals are unobserved per method, so no rule is written. limit_id and windows are supporting only. Credits, account marker, tokens and model are excluded.
No method field in the parsed transcript. Google sign-in is not labelled subscription. Default: Unknown or owner declaration.
API key, Bedrock, Vertex, gateway and mixed: no access (D-P6-14). Mixed is covered by synthetic tests only.
